user.title: Choose a configuration profile
user.description: GridPilot starts in shadow mode. Active battery control remains disabled until explicitly enabled from the integration options.

data_description.profile: Choose Victron to prefill common GX entity IDs. Choose Generic to select every entity manually.

battery.title: Configure battery measurements
battery.description: Select the entities that describe the current state of the home battery.

data_description.battery_soc: Sensor containing the current battery charge as a percentage from 0 to 100. Victron example: sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_charge.
data_description.battery_power: Sensor containing the instantaneous battery power in W or kW. The charging and discharging sign may depend on the source integration. Victron example: sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_power.

energy.title: Configure grid and home load
energy.description: Select either one total home-load sensor or all three phase sensors.

data_description.grid_setpoint: Writable number entity for the requested grid import in watts. GridPilot only writes to it when active control is explicitly enabled. Victron example: number.gx_device_ac_power_setpoint.
data_description.home_load: Sensor containing the instantaneous total home consumption in W or kW. When selected, it takes precedence over the phase sensors.
data_description.home_load_l1: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L1 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.
data_description.home_load_l2: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L2 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.
data_description.home_load_l3: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L3 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.

ev.title: Configure PV surplus and EV charging
ev.description: Entity mappings are optional. GridPilot only calculates EV current after all required mappings are configured, and never writes unless EV actuation is explicitly enabled.

data_description.grid_power: Grid power in W or kW, positive for import and negative for export.
data_description.ev_power: Current EV charging power in W or kW.
data_description.ev_connection_state: Entity whose state indicates whether an EV is connected.
data_description.ev_current_limit: Writable number entity in A. Alfen Modbus example: number.alfen_max_current_limit_s1.
data_description.ev_current_feedback: Optional sensor or number reporting the applied current limit.
data_description.ev_voltage: Phase-to-neutral voltage used to convert available power to current.
data_description.ev_phase_mode: Select or sensor whose state starts with 1 or 3.
data_description.ev_mode: Select entity used to choose the charging mode.
data_description.ev_override: When on, GridPilot relinquishes EV current control to the battery-to-EV controller.
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Enable when positive battery power means charging; disable when negative battery power means charging.
data_description.ev_pv_mode: Exact charging-mode state in which GridPilot may control PV charging.
data_description.ev_disconnected_state: Exact connection-state value meaning no EV is connected.
data_description.ev_priority: Share of available PV assigned to the EV while the home battery is below 98%.
data_description.ev_max_current: Maximum current GridPilot may request. Default: 16 A.
data_description.pv_safety_margin: Power withheld from EV charging to reduce accidental grid import.
data_description.enable_ev_actuation: Danger: enable only after every other PV controller writing to the EV current limit has been disabled. Default: off.

control.title: Configure control parameters
control.description: These values are stored inside GridPilot's Home Assistant config entry. No helpers are created.

data_description.max_grid_power: Positive maximum permitted grid import in watts. This fixed value replaces the need for a separate helper. Default: 2900 W.
data_description.charge_soc: At this SOC, the calculated setpoint equals the current home load. Maximum charging starts 5 percentage points below it and normal battery operation starts 5 percentage points above it. Default: 15%.
data_description.minimum_charge_power: Minimum extra charging power requested below the charge threshold, before applying the maximum grid-power limit. Default: 300 W.
data_description.enable_actuation: Danger: enable only after every other controller writing to the grid setpoint has been disabled. Invalid measurements and unloads reset the setpoint to 0 W. Default: off.

error.load_entities_required: Select one total load sensor or all three phase sensors

init.title: Configure the battery curve
init.description: GridPilot derives the maximum-charging and normal-operation thresholds 5 percentage points below and above the configured compensation SOC. Active control must not run alongside another setpoint controller.

data_description.max_grid_power: Positive maximum permitted grid import in watts, stored inside GridPilot. Default: 2900 W.
data_description.charge_soc: At this SOC, the calculated setpoint equals the current home load. Maximum charging starts 5 percentage points below it and normal battery operation starts 5 percentage points above it. Default: 15%.
data_description.minimum_charge_power: Minimum extra charging power requested below the charge threshold, before applying the maximum grid-power limit. Default: 300 W.
data_description.enable_actuation: Danger: enable only after every other controller writing to the grid setpoint has been disabled. Invalid measurements and unloads reset the setpoint to 0 W. Default: off.
